# Install requirements-torch.txt FIRST, in its own `pip install` command,
# then this file. flash-attn's setup.py runs `import torch` at metadata-
# generation time, which fails if torch isn't already importable in the env
# -- pip resolves/preps metadata for every package in a requirements.txt
# before installing any of them, so torch listed in the same file doesn't
# help; it has to already be installed beforehand.
